card.name: Dose and reference-range wording
card.fires_on: Words that complete a dose or range phrase, such as 'normal' before range, 'dose' or 'dosage' after 'this', and the W in IBW (ideal body weight). It appears in dosing instructions and lab-range comparisons.

modes.label: Normal range
modes.description: The word 'normal' before a reference range for a lab value such as IGF-1.
modes.example: serum IGF-1 levels above the<< normal>> reference ranges for age and sex.

modes.label: This dose
modes.description: Dose or dosage right after 'this' or 'a therapeutic' when referring back to an amount just given.
modes.example: On a body-surface-area basis, this<< dose>> is 18 times (rats)

modes.label: Ideal body weight
modes.description: The last letter W of IBW in weight-based dosing formulas.
modes.example: Use actual body weight if it is less than IB<<W>>.
